target.title: fix(qa-matrix): use truncateUtf16Safe for e2ee bootstrap error preview truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`scenario-runtime-e2ee.ts` uses naive `.slice(0, 240)` to truncate bootstrap error text for the `bootstrapErrorPreview` field in three sites. Error messages may contain non-BMP characters (emoji in channel names, Unicode user content). A naive `.slice(0, 240)` at a surrogate pair boundary produces a lone surrogate.

## Changes

- `extensions/qa-matrix/src/runners/contract/scenario-runtime-e2ee.ts`: Replace 3 `.slice(0, 240)` calls with `truncateUtf16Safe(value, 240)`

Sibling files `scenario-runtime-shared.ts` and `scenario-runtime-room.ts` already use `truncateUtf16Safe` for text truncation. This brings the e2ee file in line with the rest of the qa-matrix module.

## Evidence

The import path follows the qa-matrix convention used by sibling files:
```typescript
import { truncateUtf16Safe } from "openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime";
```

Same pattern as #102656 and #102606 which already updated the shared and room files.
